subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Analisar relações de intertextualidade e interdiscursividade que permitam a explicitação de relações dialógicas, a identificação de posicionamentos ou de perspectivas, a compreensão de paráfrases, paródias e estilizações, entre outras possibilidades.

components.description_pt: Identificar relações dialógicas entre textos através de intertextualidade e interdiscursividade
components.description_en: Identify dialogic relationships between texts through intertextuality and interdiscursivity
components.cc_component_description: Analyze differences in tone and perspective between texts of different forms on the same theme

components.description_pt: Analisar como referências intertextuais revelam a postura ou perspectiva de um autor
components.description_en: Analyze how intertextual references reveal the stance or perspective of an author
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how an author's point of view shapes their account of an event or topic

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre paráfrase, paródia e estilização como formas de relação intertextual
components.description_en: Distinguish among paraphrase, parody, and stylization as forms of intertextual relationship

components.description_pt: Interpretar os efeitos de sentido produzidos pelas relações intertextuais e interdiscursivas em um texto
components.description_en: Interpret the effects of meaning produced by intertextual and interdiscursive relations in a given text
components.cc_component_description: Interpret the meaning of an allusion based on its source and context

cc_matches.description: Analyze multiple accounts of the same event or topic, noting important similarities and differences in the point of view they represent.
Interpret figures of speech (e.g., literary, biblical, and mythological allusions) in context.
Compare and contrast texts in different forms or genres (e.g., stories and poems; historical novels and fantasy stories) in terms of their approaches to similar themes and topics.
